criteria.title: Original claim recorded accurately and in context
criteria.reviewEvidence: Inspect the precise original spoken or written statement, speaker, date, provenance and missing surrounding context.
criteria.blocker: Attribution alone verifies only what was said, never the extraordinary interpretation.

criteria.title: Corroboration from demonstrably independent evidence
criteria.reviewEvidence: Trace unique people, instruments, ownership, raw data and production lineage; do not count republished media, one interview or a shared experiment twice.
criteria.blocker: Different URLs or coauthors do not by themselves constitute independent evidence.

criteria.title: Accessible original records, measurements and custody
criteria.reviewEvidence: Inspect full source originals, unedited files, calibration, timestamps, specimen identifiers and chain of custody as relevant.
criteria.blocker: Selected pages, blocked publishers, chapter labels and indexed abstracts cannot be represented as full direct data audits.

criteria.title: Specific claim scope, methodology and testability
criteria.reviewEvidence: Define the precise physical/policy/journalistic assertion, predictions, uncertainty and expert replication where feasible.
criteria.blocker: A mathematical model cannot validate unverified reported instrument inputs.

criteria.title: Contradictions, alternatives and uncertainty
criteria.reviewEvidence: Inspect the strongest relevant alternative records and explain where they apply and where their scope is limited.
criteria.blocker: General reports do not automatically refute a later or unrelated allegation.
